(175TH COMMISSION) PILGRIMAGE ORDINANCE
The Annual Esela Feast of 2019
KOTABOWA KUDA KATHARAGAMA DEVALAYA OF UVA WELLASSA

I, herewith declaring to aware the public that Annual Feast of “Kotabowa Kuda Katharagama Devalaya of Uva Wellassa”will be started with hoisting cap on 31st July 2019 and will be ended on 15th August 2019 with Diya Kepima at dawn.
02. The regulation of the Pilgrimage Ordinance of No. 14117 of Government Gazette that declared on 24th July1964 will be valid in the festival season accordingly.
D. S. PATHMAKULASOORIYA,District Secretary/Government Agent,Officer in charge of Kotabowa KudaKatharagama Devalaya,Esela festival work Force.
District Secretairat,Monaragala.14th July 2019.

The Annual Esela Feast of 2019KOTABOWA KUDA KATHARAGAMA DEVALAYA OF UVA WELLASSA
I, herewith declare the Pilgrimage Ordinance of No. 14117 of Government Gazette that published on 24th July 1964 for thepublic attention and announcing the regulations and below mentioned substance.
01. Camp Area :The area covers from so called “Dahamal Oya” of inner Kotabowa ancient ford within half mile of quasi diameters.

02. Constructing Buildings :Constructing permanent or temporary building prohibited inner the camp areas in between the period of 31stJuly 2019 and will be ended on 15th August 2019 without a written permission of me or an accredited officerof me.
03. Beggers :Begging, obtaining & providing dime and distributing are prohibited in the sacred and the camp area.
04. Bathing & Washing :Bathing, washing, washing animals or washing vehicles are prohibited in the area so called “Dahamal Oya” ofinner Kotabowa ancient ford with in half of mile of quasi diameter.
05. Vehilcels :
05.01 Vehicle such as automobile, bicycle, bullock carts or any are prohibited to enter to the sacred area (to“Dahamal Oya” east) without my permission or an accredited person of mine.
05.02 Prohibited to park vehicles except the reserved parking area of the market in the camp.
06. Kavadi Shop :Prohibited to establish any kavadi shop in the area without any permission or the accredited officer of mine.
07. Business :
07.01 Prohibited to auction or lease any temporary shops in the camp area without my written permission or anaccredited person and no one will be permitted to do as such in the prohibited area.
07.02 Construction & extending buildings, making tents, encroaching the riverbeds in camp area or in the sacredarea are prohibited.
07.03 Selling foods items, ritual things & trays of fruit, ice cream and holy ash are prohibited to sell except thereserved area which permitted by me or an accredited officer of mine.

07.04 A trash bin of 4 1/2 cubic feet has to be placed at every buildings and the constructions where business ortrade take place and the bins have to be kept closed by lids when they are not in use and must kept outsidethe premises in time for elimination as convenient to the workers of health.
07.05 All the food items and beverages that for selling and consumption have to be arranged in containers and tobe protected by the files.

08. Sanitation and Public Health :
The excretion is prohibited except the reserved location and the solid and liquid trash mustn’t be placed exceptthe bins in the camp area.
This Ordinance that declared by me shouldn’t be violated by onyone.
D. S. PATHMAKULASOORIYA,District Secretary/Government Agent,Officer in charge of Kotabowa KudaKatharagama Devalaya,Esela festival work Force.
